Sending Mu'adh to People of the Book in Yemen, the Prophet told him to call them first to the testimony, then prayer, then Zakat, without taking their best property.
When 'Warn your nearest kindred' was revealed, the Prophet called Quraysh's clans and his family, warning he could not avail them against Allah; Abu Lahab retorted, and his surah followed.
Sending companions on missions, including Mu'adh to Yemen, the Prophet told them to give glad tidings, be lenient and not harsh, and not create aversion.
Heraclius questions Abu Sufyan about the Prophet, then reads his letter inviting him to Islam; the Prophet also wrote inviting Chosroes, the Negus and every other ruler to Allah.
